import os,hashlib,re,datetime
from pathlib import Path
roots=[Path('/opt'),Path('/home/ubuntu')]
seen=set()
for base in roots:
 if not base.is_dir(): continue
 try: ds=sorted(base.iterdir(),key=lambda x:x.name)
 except (OSError,PermissionError) as e: print('ROOT_INACCESSIBLE',str(base),type(e).__name__); continue
 for d in ds:
  if d.is_symlink() or not d.is_dir():continue
  if not any(w in d.name.lower() for w in ('telegram','robot','leads')):continue
  if d in seen:continue
  seen.add(d)
  print('PROJECT_DIR',str(d),'OWNER_UID',d.stat().st_uid)
  records=[]
  for dirpath, dirs, files in os.walk(d,followlinks=False):
   depth=len(Path(dirpath).relative_to(d).parts)
   dirs[:]=sorted([x for x in dirs if x not in ('.venv','venv','node_modules','.git','__pycache__','site-packages') and not (Path(dirpath)/x).is_symlink()]) if depth<4 else []
   if depth>4:continue
   for fname in files:
    p=Path(dirpath)/fname
    if p.is_symlink():continue
    suffix=p.suffix.lower()
    if suffix not in ('.json','.sqlite','.sqlite3','.db','.bak','.old','.zip','.gz','.tar','.csv'):continue
    if fname.startswith('.env') or suffix=='.session':continue
    try: stat=p.stat()

    if stat.st_size > 50_000_000:continue
    display=re.sub(r'\d{5,}','[id]',str(p.relative_to(d)))
    records.append((display,stat.st_size,p))
  print('DATA_FILE_COUNT',len(records))
  for name,size,p in sorted(records,key=lambda x:x[0])[:85]:print('FILE',name,'BYTES',size,'DATE',datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(p.stat().st_mtime,datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))

   p=d/rel
   if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink():
    bs=p.read_bytes()
